notes.title: UPCOMING UPDATE FOR “HORNY WARP”
notes.notes:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41359427/f28135598f740fe3faede6c5264191dd44dd9165.png"]
Hi everyone! It’s been a while since our last update - time to fix that.
When we finished “Horny Warp”, our team promised to release additional content as a thank-you for your support and interest in the game. Quite a lot of time has passed since then, but we’re still standing by our word: the expansion will happen - [strike]sooner[/strike] or later. We already have some of the artwork, a clear concept, and the determination to see it through. What remains is the hardest part - managing our resources and time wisely.

Right now, the Luminati Games team (in case you missed it, we had to change our studio’s name - the story’s on Twitter/X) is focused on finishing “Girls, I Just Want to Get PAID”. This game is a little different from “Horny Warp”, but we’re confident it will be just as fun and sexy. So if you’d like to support us, please consider adding “Girls, I Just Want to Get PAID” to your wishlist. We’re hopeful that we’ll be able to share some very good news about the game soon!

[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3682700/Girls_I_just_want_to_get_paid"][/dynamiclink]Coming back to “Horny Warp” — even though we’re also developing our third game, “Horny Kingdom”, we’re doing our best to prioritize finishing Fuckville’s story. “Horny Warp” will always hold a special place in our hearts, and we want to make sure every promise we’ve made is fulfilled.

Very soon, the little wagon you see in the attached image will come to life, and inside it you’ll meet a brand-new character. Until then, thank you so much for your endless support. 
See you soon, friends! ːWarpSmoochː

notes.title: UPDATE V1.1.0
ONE WEEK BEFORE RELEASE
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41359427/0fbb9b1e0e4350ff9754fb0bf0e2ddc589c46708.jpg
Hi everybody!

Only seven days left until the release of “Horny Warp”!
We hope you are as excited as we are! Our team has made every effort to complete the game by the release date while maintaining quality. Now we already have the final build, and all that remains for us is to tweak the balance of the minigames and catch all the bugs so that nothing spoils your experience from the game.
In the year and a half that we have been creating “Horny Warp”, our team has learned a lot, and we can’t wait to start working on additional content for this game. It was made possible thanks to your support!

In just seven days, you will embark on a magical journey to Fuckville! Hooray!
Add “Horny Warp” to your wishlist and follow so you don't miss the news.

notes.title: UPDATED RELEASE DATE AND DEMO UPDATE OF "HORNY WARP"
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41359427/3a31c6c4df814e0910330a7fa11f786f7a362c3d.png
Hello everyone!
We will start this devlog with the news about delaying the release of “Horny Warp.” If previously we set the release somewhere in January, then now we are ready to announce the exact release date - February 17. 
Of course, the game will release somewhat later than you expected, but our team needs the time to finish the game without compromising its quality. We are sure you also share our wish for “Horny Warp” to release at its best, and that's why we believe you will understand our decision. To make everyone happy, however, we have prepared a surprise!

We have updated the demo for “Horny Warp”. You will get one more minigame and the first H-scene with priestess Lilyan. This will help you get a better feel for the game and pass the time until its full release. 
We have also prepared the Mac OS build! Now every owner of Mac OS devices will be able to play the “Horny Warp” demo. The final version of the game will also be compatible with Mac OS.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41359427/fca6c5bdeddaad9c0c34fc81b0baef3ac7e58cbb.png

And there's even more good news!
Lately, “Horny Warp” has received an enormous amount of support and attention. This greatly inspired our team, and we have plans to support the game for a long time to come. 
We are going to add one H-scene and one side story for every girl! We won't give any details before the release of the main build, though. Our first priority is releasing “Horny Warp,” and the additional content comes second. 

We would like to apologize again for the release delay. Anyway, you won't be waiting for long!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1539160/Horny_Warp_Hentai_Fantasy/

Thank you for your interest in our game! Don't forget to wishlist the game and follow.
With love, Luminati Games.
